groups.reasoning: A deadpan numbered-list-of-reasons format with a fixed punchline word -- no persona or subject lock-in, trivially re-skinned around any product or premise.
A lyric-synced photo carousel structure is a transferable narrative container -- any set of images/beats can be swapped in.
A reveal-your-favorite-thing format maps cleanly onto a small-victory/pride beat and works for any object or feature.
A delayed-realization structure (a memory on screen, the sound landing at the exact moment it clicks) is a generic narrative device usable with any subject.
A pure choreographed dance-to-a-song challenge with no narrative arc, hook, or resolution to adapt -- the entire format is the dance execution itself.
